day6_stories.title: Expired card recovered
day6_stories.note: card_expired. Agent skips debit, sends instrument-update; customer replaces the card. B would have retried the dead instrument.

day6_stories.title: Policy, not gate
day6_stories.note: mandate_creation_failed, no stored authorisation. Policy never proposes retry_debit — it goes straight to request_mandate_reauth. The mandate gate exists; on this row it never has to fire.

day6_stories.title: Opt-out gate
day6_stories.note: opted-out NSF. Policy proposed retry_debit; gate rejected it; mark_uncollectible(opted_out). The illegal debit never ran.

day6_stories.title: Downtime wait
day6_stories.note: technical_downtime with mandate: wait_for_downtime_recovery, zero messages, then retry. Did not contact a blameless customer during the outage.

day6_stories.title: Attempts exhausted
day6_stories.note: issuer_decline. Two payment-link asks, then mark_uncollectible(attempt_budget). The agent knows when to stop.

day6_stories.title: High-value NSF
day6_stories.note: ₹46,535 insufficient_funds, flagged for review. Flag is audit, not a freeze. Same id retrieves POL-002.
